tei:div.tei:p: 1)༄༅/ oṃ swa sti/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo'i zab gter chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi glegs bam/ e) rtags can 'dir/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi kha byang ka la piṅka'i sgra tshig yang byang gab thig ldeb/ ḍā ki'i gsang tshig u pa de sha ldeb/ rang gter zab chos kyi shog tshad nyams snang ma ldeb/ o rgyan rnam thar padma dkar po ldeb/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor skal ldan lam grol ldeb/ bcas/ ༄/ bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i skor la/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin dpung ldeb/ byin 'bebs bdud rtsi'i thig le ldeb/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu ldeb/ 'dzab bskul dngos grub bum bzang ldeb/ brgyud 'debs byin rlabs dpal phreng ldeb/ nang sgrub rin chen 2)dbang rgyal ldeb/ tshogs mchod rig 'dzin dgyes skong dngos grub myur thob ldeb/ gsang sgrub rdo rje'i rgya can mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud ldeb/ nyer spyod mchod bstod ldeb/ bdud rtsi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus dpa' bo gcig sgrub ldeb/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs sprin phung ldeb/ tshe sgrub yang gsang snying po ldeb/ dbang gi sta gon smin grol lam bzang ldeb/ dbang gi lhan thabs dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun ldeb/ dbang chog ye shes drwa ba byin rlabs char 'bebs ldeb/ don dbang 'brel tshad rang grol gab pa mngon phyung ldeb/ lha dbang don bsdus ḍā kis gsungs pa ldeb/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub dngos grub mchog ster rdo rje'i rgyan can dang*/ tshogs mchod/ mchod bstod bcas ldeb/ bcas/ ༄/ thugs rje chen po'i skor la 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster ldeb/ bskyed rdzogs cho ga dngos grub 'byung gnas ldeb/ rtsa sgrub la byang chub lam 3)bzang dngos grub snye ma ldeb/ cho ga'i cha lag las rim bdun pa ldeb/ bskang bshags zab mo ldeb/ me mchod las bzhi lhun grub ldeb/

zhal sgrub dngos grub snye ma ldeb/ zhal sgrub rgyun khyer zab mo ldeb/ rtsa dbang ye shes snang 'byed ldeb/ dbang gi cha lag gab thig ldeb/ bcas/ ༄/ rta mgrin skor la/ dbang chen brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ sngon 'gro'i 'jug chos bcas ldeb/ padma dbang gi sgrub thabs khams gsum rnam rgyal ratna'i rgya can ldeb/ don bskang yid bzhin sprin phung ldeb/ rtsa sgrub ye shes rab 'bar ldeb/ sgrub thabs rgyun khyer zab mo ldeb/ drag bskul rdo rje'i thog mda' ldeb/ drag sgrub pha rol dpung 'joms ldeb/ drag po'i las sbyor ldeb/ gtor zlog bsdus pa ldeb/ rtsa dbang byin rlabs gter mdzod 4) ldeb/ bcas/ ༄/ sgrol ma'i skod la/ 'phags ma'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster ldeb/ sgrub thabs byin rlabs dpal ster ldeb/ rjes gnang gter gyi bum bzang ldeb/ bcas/ ༄/ rdo rje phag mo'i skor la/ mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs zab mo ldeb/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i rgya can ldeb/ bskang ba byin rlabs dbyig thob mos pa'i do shal ldeb/ bskang bsdus tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs ldeb/ nang sgrub rgyun khyer gsang ba'i can ldeb/ tshogs mchod ye shes sprin phung ldeb/ gsang sgrub padma'i rgya can yang zab snying po ldeb/ tshogs mchod rgyun khyer ldeb/ yang gsang rtsa sgrub rgyun khyer 'od gsal snying po ldeb/ nyer mkho rjes kyi rim pa ldeb/ gsang sgrub rgyun khyer zab pa'i snying po dang*/ gsang ye'i gsol 'debs dbang gi chu bo bcas ldeb/ snyan brgyud yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i 5) srog sgrub gsang rgya can ldeb/ phag mo'i las tshogs yid bzhin nor bu ldeb/ srid 'phel 'khor lo 'dod 'byung dbang rgyal ldeb/ dmar bshal 'gog sngags sogs nyer mkho'i sngags 'bum ldeb/ bla rdo srog 'khor zab rgya can ldeb/ me mchod dngos grub chu gter ldeb/ myur mdzad dbang mo'i sgrub thabs ratna'i rgya can dang*/

sgrol ma'i bstod bsdus dngos grub nor gter nang gses tshan pa gsum can bcas ldeb/ 'byung lus 'khrul zhig gi gdams pa sgyu lus lhar ldang ldeb/ gsang ba'i dbang bzhi nges don mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin phung ldeb/ bcas le tshan bdun cu don gnyis dang*/ glegs bam gyi dkar chag rang nyid ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb grangs bzhugs so// mtshungs med ḍā ki bde skyong dbang mo yi// zab gter mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chos sde'i gzhung*/ 6) /rig 'dzin dbang mos spar du btab spel mthus// zab chos phrin las mi nub mthar rgyas shog /grub brnyes rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i 'khor los sgyur// sngon med gdams zab mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdag /mkha' spyod dbang mo bde ba'i rdo rje yi// ring lugs phyogs mthar 'phel rgyas rtag khyab shog dzñā nas so//
